headline: Two killed in Israeli airstrike on vehicle in southern Gaza City (Tel Al-Hawa); one man killed on a bike in Khan Yunis; one woman
dek: Two killed in Israeli airstrike on vehicle in southern Gaza City (Tel Al-Hawa); one man killed on a bike in Khan Yunis; one woman killed by gunfire near Jabalya camp. IDF said it struck a Hamas militant in Khan Yunis; checking Tel Al-Hawa/Jabalya reports.
sources: Gaza health officials via Haaretz; Reuters; IDF statement
fault_line: Is this still a ceasefire, or a war that never stopped? (Guardian editorial: 'ceasefires that aren't')

sections.what_happened: Two killed in Israeli airstrike on vehicle in southern Gaza City (Tel Al-Hawa); one man killed on a bike in Khan Yunis; one woman killed by gunfire near Jabalya camp. IDF said it struck a Hamas militant in Khan Yunis; checking Tel Al-Hawa/Jabalya reports. Gaza Health Ministry: >=1,500 killed since ceasefire; Israel: 4 soldiers killed.
sections.what_verified: Haaretz + Reuters (citing medics) + Al Jazeera/Quds News (citing Al-Shifa officials). Reuters photo (Dawoud Abu Alkas) of burning vehicle wreckage in Gaza City.
sections.what_disputed: IDF only confirms the Khan Yunis strike as a Hamas militant; other two incidents under check. Israel says military leaders pushing to resume war (Israel Army Radio via Guardian editorial) — contested internally, not a confirmed decision.
sections.why_matters: Continuation beat: count the violations, name the method (drone on vehicle, gunfire, bike strike). Ceasefire violations alone: 1,534 killed, 5,486 injured (Gaza Health Ministry).
sections.context: Background: Gaza — UPDATE: 4 Palestinians killed by IDF in Gaza on Thursday (Haaretz); strikes persist under ceasefire

totw_analysis: Our read: Continuation beat: count the violations, name the method (drone on vehicle, gunfire, bike strike). Ceasefire violations alone: 1,534 killed, 5,486 injured (Gaza Health Ministry). The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is this still a ceasefire, or a war that never stopped? (Guardian editorial: 'ceasefires that aren't')
